words.prose: {{ar:سَنَسِمُهُۥ}} ({{tr:sanasimuhū}}) opens the ayah as a future first-person plural decree, so the punishment is not narrated as something already happened or left agentless; the divine speaker enters the grammar as the one who will impose it. The attached object suffix keeps the target as the same unnamed masculine figure from the previous portrait, while the following {{ar:عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā l-khurṭūmi}}) separates the person affected from the exact surface marked. Lexically, the verb carries physical branding and visible designation together: the mark is placed on a body surface, but it also makes the person's status publicly readable. That matters after 68:15, where signs were recited upon him and dismissed; here rejected signs are answered by an imposed sign on him. The compact first word fuses futurity, agent, action, and patient before the delayed snout-locus arrives, making the ayah feel like a terse verdict rather than an explanation; its rare IV branding profile and m-sound also bind the act forward to the final marked surface.

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the small hinge that turns a general act of marking him into a mark placed upon a specified surface. It governs {{ar:ٱلْخُرْطُومِ}} ({{tr:al-khurṭūmi}}) in the genitive and attaches the locative phrase to {{ar:سَنَسِمُهُۥ}} ({{tr:sanasimuhū}}), so the punishment is not a second object but the visible place where the brand lands. The particle also carries the boundary from 68:15: signs were recited upon him there, and the mark is placed upon the snout here. Because the preposition stands as its own word before the heavy final noun, the clause pivots audibly from the punished person to the anatomical target.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْخُرْطُومِ}} ({{tr:al-khurṭūmi}}) closes the ayah as the definite genitive object of {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), so the last word is not the agent or the act but the branded surface. Its definiteness makes the target pointed: the snout is treated as the recognizable place where disgrace will be displayed. The V4-supported local branch is snout, nose, or trunk; leader, wine, and other branches do not govern this occurrence. Because the referent is human while the noun belongs to animal snout, trunk, and protruding-face imagery, the word degrades the face into an exposed animalized surface. Its one-time Quranic occurrence and five-letter shape intensify that shock, and the back guttural, emphatic stop, long-vowel-plus-final-m sound leave the snout as the ayah's last acoustic residue. In the broader sign system, face-marking at 48:29 and recognition by marks at 55:41 become here a punitive, humiliating version focused on the most visible protrusion.

topics.headline: human face named as snout
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the humiliation sharpen because a human referent is marked through snout, trunk, and protruding-face imagery rather than a neutral human nose term.
topics.reason: V4 supports the snout, nose, trunk, or face-by-part branch for the local form; modern nozzle or interface extensions are narrowed to protruding contact-surface pressure and do not replace the anatomical snout sense.

topics.headline: one-time five-letter noun intensifies shock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah spends a rare, five-letter, corpus-unique word on the target surface, making the degradation feel purpose-built.
topics.reason: The contextual and supplied occurrence evidence treat {{ar:ٱلْخُرْطُومِ}} ({{tr:al-khurṭūmi}}) as a one-time Quranic root occurrence, and QAC identifies the root as five-lettered.

topics.headline: punitive face-marking echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place this snout mark within Quranic recognition-by-mark language, but as its degrading punitive version rather than the honorable mark of 48:29 or the recognition scene of 55:41.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete references to 48:29 and 55:41; they function as comparative face-marking evidence while the local noun remains the snout target in 68:16.

topics.headline: harsh final sound leaves the snout
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close on the rare snout word, with rough consonants and nasal weight making the degraded target the final acoustic image.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future verb سنسمه supplies an imposed mark, while على fixes it on الخرطوم, the prominent nose or snout and potentially the face by part-for-whole reference.
baseline_models.mechanism: An otherwise unspecified consequence becomes bodily and publicly legible: the most exposed central feature carries the identifying damage.

activation_trace.role: The nose, animal snout, and face-by-part image supplies the conspicuous bodily surface on which the structurally supplied mark becomes readable.

changed_reading.before: A punishment will somehow reach the addressee.
changed_reading.after: A future agent-applied sign will be fixed to the exposed nose or face so that the body itself bears recognition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The marked الخرطوم can name not only a nose but a chief or leading man.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mark attacks social prominence through the body-part that lexically doubles as leadership: rank is made into its bearer’s point of exposure.

activation_trace.role: The chiefs-of-a-people image lets the marked feature carry a second, social referent: the person’s leading status.

changed_reading.before: The nose alone is selected for physical disgrace.
changed_reading.after: The person’s chiefly standing is struck at its lexical emblem, so public rank and bodily exposure coincide.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus noun carries an image of angry arrogance expressed by lifting the head.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mark is aimed at a posture as well as an organ: self-elevation presents the very site on which reversal will be displayed.

activation_trace.role: Raised-headed angry arrogance turns the marked nose or head into a visible posture of pride rather than a neutral anatomical location.

changed_reading.before: A neutral facial location receives a mark.
changed_reading.after: The lifted head of angry self-importance exposes itself as the chosen location of its own reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with writing, then the profiled speaker relabels recited signs as false old writing; the promised facial mark answers by turning the denier’s own body into an undeniable counter-inscription.

activation_trace.role: The exposed nose or face supplies the receiving surface for the counter-inscription.
The prepared writing reed supplies the act of durable inscription that the bodily mark echoes.
The ordered written line makes the opening writing motif a legible record rather than generic speech.
The visible-sign image supplies what the speaker refuses to recognize and what his marked face will itself become.
The false-tales branch supplies his dismissive counter-label, which the bodily inscription reverses.

structural_cues: 68:15 immediately presents his relabeling of the recited signs, and 68:16 immediately answers with the future first-person-plural marking.
The branchless focus root و س م remains only the structural act of marking; no branch identifier is inferred for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, visible signs, their dismissal as false writing, and a mark on the face; I supply the arrow that the mark functions as a counter-text written on the refuser. The live alternative is a simple sequence of insult and punishment without an inscription mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The mark is a standalone facial penalty.
changed_reading.after: The body becomes the answering text: one who calls the signs false writing is made to carry a visible sign that cannot be verbally relabeled away.

context_deltas.mechanism: A disputed inner disposition is converted into outward evidence: the focus mark gives the concealed moral state an identifying trace, and later disclosure vocabulary sharpens its evidentiary function.

activation_trace.role: The visible face supplies the public surface on which inward character can be externalized.
The inward-disposition image establishes character as something ordinarily interior and not directly seen.
A distinguishing trace that guides recognition gives the facial mark an epistemic role: it identifies what judgment already knows.
The exposure of a thing and its defect supplies the later disclosure pattern that the mark anticipates.

structural_cues: The focus construction places an identifying action directly on the face after a long character profile in 68:10-15.
The same passage repeatedly contrasts claims about mentality and character with who truly knows and what will become visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner disposition, a distinguishing trace, disclosure of defect, and a facial mark; I infer that the mark externalizes known character as recognizable evidence. It may alternatively be punitive without diagnosing the preceding traits.

changed_reading.before: The mark merely hurts or humiliates.
changed_reading.after: The mark makes a previously contestable interior identity publicly identifiable, translating moral diagnosis into visible evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby profile grounds status in wealth, sons, and attachment to a people, while a ز ن م branch supplies a sign of nobility; the promised mark replaces socially claimed pedigree with an imposed counter-sign on the chief-like face.

activation_trace.role: The chiefly-men image locates the reversal in claimed social prominence.
The person attached onto a people supplies precarious group membership beneath the claim to chiefly rank.
A conferred sign of nobility supplies the honor-mark whose social direction is inverted by the imposed focus mark.
Accumulated wealth supplies one asserted basis of the person’s social weight.
Lineage and attribution to an origin supply the second asserted basis of pedigree.

structural_cues: The sequence moves without a break from زنيم through wealth and sons to the promised marking in 68:13-16.
The focus noun’s leadership branch permits a social reading without replacing its bodily anchor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attached membership, an honor-sign, wealth, lineage, and a chiefly focus branch; I infer that the divine mark overwrites a socially manufactured badge of pedigree. The alternative is that each item independently intensifies blame with no badge-replacement relation.

changed_reading.before: A prominent man is disgraced on the nose.
changed_reading.after: An imposed public counter-sign overwrites wealth-and-lineage claims to chiefly belonging, converting pedigree from protection into exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular profile withholds good; the garden owners then plan to cut while excluding the poor and awaken to a cut-off garden and their own deprivation. The focus mark can therefore be carried as reciprocal externalization: exclusion imposed on others returns as visible subtraction from the agent’s own face or standing.

activation_trace.role: The marked face provides the personal surface on which reciprocal deprivation can become visible.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the initiating social action.
Cutting the palm crop supplies the owners’ planned material means of securing exclusion.
Cutting and separation return as the condition of the garden itself, reversing agent and patient.
Missing the desired good completes the return of deprivation upon those who intended it for others.

structural_cues: 68:17 begins with an explicit comparison of the addressed group’s testing to the garden owners immediately after the focus threat.
The garden sequence repeats intention, reversal, recognition, and visible aftermath rather than merely sharing a punishment topic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, intended cutting, a cut-off result, deprivation, and an explicit comparison; I infer a reciprocal arrow from imposed exclusion to self-inscribing loss. The alternative is analogy at the level of testing only, with no mechanism transferred to the facial mark.

changed_reading.before: The mark is an arbitrary stigma attached to bad conduct.
changed_reading.after: The mark participates in a reciprocal economy: the one who subtracts good from others comes to display subtraction on his own exposed self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch’s raised-headed arrogance is answered later by calls to bow, lowered eyes, lost elevation, and humiliation; the mark begins a postural status reversal whose endpoint is failed self-lowering under imposed abasement.

activation_trace.role: Raised-headed angry arrogance supplies the initial elevated posture at the marked site.
Bowing the head supplies the voluntary downward posture that the later subjects cannot perform.
The hump whose prominence has gone supplies a bodily image of erased elevation.
Breaking under overpowering force supplies the imposed abasement that replaces willing humility.

structural_cues: The focus preposition places the action on the head’s projecting feature, while 68:42-43 organize judgment through bodily height, bowing, and lowered vision.
The baseline posture reading remains distinct from the anatomical and chiefly readings even though all share الخرطوم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies raised-head arrogance, bowing, vanished bodily prominence, and abasement; I infer a trajectory from self-elevation at the focus to forced lowering later. The alternative is that the later prostration scene concerns a broader group without developing the focus posture.

changed_reading.before: The proud head merely receives a local mark.
changed_reading.after: The mark initiates a height reversal: the head raised in anger is publicly brought into a condition where elevation is lost and lowering is no longer freely available.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later matching future first-person-plural action proceeds degree by degree under extended time and firm control; this reopens سنسمه as the culminative sign of a process, not necessarily a single instantaneous branding event.

activation_trace.role: The final visible facial sign supplies the endpoint whose temporal production is being revised.
Taking degree after degree supplies a staged mechanism rather than an abrupt transition.
Extended time and respite supply the duration in which the staged process unfolds.
Extended solidity supplies the controlling force that makes delay purposeful rather than weak.

structural_cues: سنسمه in 68:16 and سنستدرجهم in 68:44 share future marking and first-person-plural agency.
The explicit sequence of gradual taking and temporal extension supplies a later temporal gloss without fixing the mark’s physical technique.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel future agency, stepwise taking, extension, and firmness; I infer that the mark may be the accumulated process made visible. The live alternative is an immediate mark followed by a separate gradual judgment of others.

changed_reading.before: The future verb predicts one sudden branding act.
changed_reading.after: The mark can be the eventual visible seal of a controlled, extended descent carried out degree by degree.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later counterfactual combines being cast into exposure with blame, and the blame root contains a facial or nasal blemish branch. That collision lets the focus mark materialize social censure as an actual visible defect at precisely the named organ.

activation_trace.role: The nose or face supplies the exact anatomical location needed by the later blemish image.
Blame and fault supply the social judgment that can be embodied by the mark.
A blemish specifically on the face or nose supplies the material form in which blame can become visible.
Removal of covering supplies the exposed condition in which the blemish cannot be hidden.

structural_cues: 68:49 presents exposure and blame together but as a rescued counterfactual, creating contrast rather than identifying its subject with the focus target.
The focus’s branchless marking verb and explicit nasal location provide the anchoring structure for the later lexical collision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blame, a face-or-nose blemish, exposure, and the focus nose; I infer that censure is materialized as visible facial defect. The alternative is that the blemish branch is an accidental lexical echo and 68:49 only contrasts rescue with rejection.

changed_reading.before: The mark signifies disgrace from outside.
changed_reading.after: Disgrace takes material form as a nasal blemish: blame is not merely said about the person but made visible on him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later challenge demands judgment, a binding writing, and a guarantor for uncertain claims; the focus mark can function as the opposing adjudicative seal, fixing a judgment on the claimant when no warrant can be produced for him.

activation_trace.role: The chiefly-person image makes the marked target a social claimant whose authority can be adjudicated.
Judgment between parties supplies the forensic frame in which competing classifications are resolved.
A written determination that imposes judgment supplies the binding-record analogue for the bodily mark.
Speech without certainty supplies the unsupported claim that cannot rival the imposed sign.
Assuming guarantee supplies the demanded warrant whose absence leaves the claimant exposed.

structural_cues: 68:35-41 repeatedly asks for the basis, document, oath, guarantor, partners, and truth behind a claimed classification.
A mark placed on the body can coexist with the counter-inscription reading while adding the narrower force of an executed judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjudication, binding writing, uncertain assertion, guarantee, and a marked chief; I infer that the mark acts as an executed verdict when the rival claim lacks warrant. The alternative is that the legal questions address eschatological preference without commenting on the earlier mark.

changed_reading.after: The mark is also verdict-like: an unsupported claimant receives a binding classification on his own person.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the close, hostile viewers try to dislodge the messenger with their eyes and repeat the madness label. Read back through the chief branch, the focus mark reverses that visual aggression: the slandering side’s prominent figure becomes the object seen, identified, and slipped from station.

activation_trace.role: The chief or leading-man image supplies the social station vulnerable to displacement.
Sliding a thing away from its station supplies the reversal from attempted bodily harm to loss of social footing.
Vision by the eye supplies the hostile medium that is reversed when the marked aggressor becomes the visible object.
Saying of someone what is not so supplies the repeated verbal attack that the visible counter-sign answers.

structural_cues: The closing accusation of madness repeats the opening accusation in 68:2 and closes the loop around the singular profiled opponent.
The focus mark is on the most gaze-accessible facial feature, so visibility is functional rather than decorative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile sight, attempted displacement from station, false attribution, and a chief marked visibly; I infer reciprocal reversal from viewer to viewed and from attempted dislodgment to loss of rank. The alternative is a direct physical threat to the messenger unrelated to the earlier singular target.

changed_reading.before: A chief is physically marked and socially embarrassed.
changed_reading.after: The mark reverses weaponized spectatorship: the accusing gaze produces no displacement of the messenger, while its own prominent representative becomes visibly classified and loses footing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because syntax and the dominant focus branch strongly favor the nose, yet the focus noun itself has a wine branch and the nearby moral descriptor has an independent wine branch. It remains lexically anchored as a secondary material activation, but downstream prose should label it wordplay-like and must not replace the anatomical reading with an assertion about literal wine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun الخرطوم carries a branch naming wine, while the marking construction can be heard secondarily as attaching a stain or sign to the intoxicant register.

activation_trace.role: The wine image opens a materially intoxicant layer inside the exact focus noun.
The independent naming of wine through the sin root activates the otherwise remote wine branch in the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: The mark belongs only to facial anatomy and public status.
changed_reading.after: A contained secondary layer lets the mark register as the visible stain of an intoxicant appetite already latent in the profiled sinfulness.

It remains anchored in the focus face and the structural marking act, with three independent packet images converging on facial distribution, shaping by cutting, and a cutting line. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory scar-or-scoring model, not as a lexical translation of سنسمه.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The nose can stand for the face, allowing an imposed mark to alter the face’s distribution rather than merely add an abstract stigma.

activation_trace.role: The nose and face-by-part image supplies the bounded surface whose appearance is altered.
Beauty apportioned across the face supplies an existing facial order that a mark can redistribute or break.
Cutting and paring a hard thing to shape supplies a material technique for making the mark.
A striking or cutting line supplies the scar-like geometry of the imposed facial sign.

changed_reading.before: The face receives an unspecified sign.
changed_reading.after: The sign may be imagined as a scored line that materially re-apportions facial appearance, making disrupted beauty itself legible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reversal is surprising because it activates the animal snout inside a human insult and links distant driving vocabulary. It remains anchored in the focus noun’s explicit animal analogue and in the subject’s nearby violent-dragging trait. Downstream prose should qualify it as an animalizing role reversal, not claim a literal transformation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun can denote an animal snout, so marking it can recode a violently dominant human body through an animal-driving frame.

activation_trace.role: The animal-snout analogue supplies the bodily recoding while preserving the literal nasal anchor.
Violent dragging and coercive driving supply the target’s active social role before reversal.
Driving or expelling supplies the later passive role into which the former coercer can be imaginatively recoded.
Fast, compliant movement supplies the final contrast to the target’s earlier refusal of moral guidance.

changed_reading.before: A brutal man is insulted by a mark on his nose.
changed_reading.after: The violent driver is symbolically recoded at the snout as the driven creature, reversing coercive agency without requiring literal metamorphosis.

strongest_changes: The facial mark becomes a counter-inscription: refusal of written and visible signs ends with the refuser’s body made into one.
The mark becomes identifying evidence that externalizes inward character rather than merely inflicting pain.
The chief and raised-head branches turn the act into a reversal of pedigree, rank, and bodily elevation.
Parallel future agency, gradual taking, and extended time allow the mark to be the visible culmination of a process.
The facial-or-nasal blemish branch of ذ م م makes blame materially coincide with the focus location.
summary.what_was_special: The packet produced unusually exact cross-root collisions around one compact ayah: an identifying trace, a visible sign rejected as false writing, an honor-mark attached to pedigree, beauty distributed over the face, and a blemish specifically on face or nose. These support several mechanisms at once rather than forcing a choice between literal branding, social demotion, epistemic disclosure, and materialized blame.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus root و س م has no branch inventory, so it supports only the structural act of marking; the mark’s technique and material cannot be branch-cited.
The chief, wine, and raised-head readings are valid branches of الخرطوم but differ sharply in syntactic and contextual strength.
The garden owners, the later judged group, and the singular profiled opponent need not be one referent; transfers between them are analogical mechanisms, not identity claims.
The wine convergence and facial-scoring model should remain explicitly exploratory because the anatomical nose reading is substantially stronger.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Hidden character made externally legible.** `و س م B001` is a visible identifying mark and `و س م B002` a sign read by discerning observation; `خ ر ط م B001` supplies nose/snout and part-for-whole face. The future verb answers the earlier concealed-state accusation and trait catalogue. I infer inward pattern -> outward sign; the ayah promises that disputed character will become publicly readable.
2. **Arrogant leadership marked at its raised organ.** `خ ر ط م B002/B004` supplies leaders and angry arrogance with raised head. The location *ʿalā al-khurṭūm* targets the bodily image by which hauteur presents itself. I infer the organ displaying elevation becomes the site of reversal; the mark reads as a demotion of claimed rank as well as a physical stigma.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:42-43 made marking part of a larger disclosure sequence: cover is removed, posture fails, and abasement becomes visible in the eyes. 68:51's attempted use of eyes against the addressee then reverses direction, showing the markers themselves marked by how they look.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A mark that converts hidden character into readable evidence.** Fixed `نَسِمُه` activates `و س م B002` (a sign read by discerning observation), after tale-bearing's faint traces in 68:11 and the verbal dossier of 68:12-15. The packet supplies indirect signs followed by a promised visible one; I infer an arrow from concealed conduct to publicly diagnosable trace. The marking reads as evidentiary disclosure, not arbitrary decoration.
2. **Leadership's raised front brought under identification.** Fixed `ٱلْخُرْطُوم` activates `خ ر ط م B002` (leaders of a people) and `خ ر ط م B004` (angry arrogance with raised head). Wealth and sons in 68:14 and the garden owners' controlling oath in 68:17 supply status and command; I infer that marking the snout symbolically targets the elevated front by which arrogance leads others. The punishment addresses a social posture and its influence, not only a body part.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:17's oath-taking owners supplied a miniature leadership structure immediately after the fixed mark. That made `ٱلْخُرْطُوم` activate both arrogant raised posture and communal leadership (`خ ر ط م B004/B002`), so the mark targets influence as well as face.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A surface becomes socially legible when lines, colors, marks, or attached signs assign content and identity to it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The opening pen and closing facial brand belong to one material semiotics: inscription may preserve truth, fabricate reputation, or fasten an identity to a body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Body Is Read Through Brand, Appendage, and Facial Sign
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A cut or burned mark, a conspicuous appendage, and facial features become indices by which a person or animal is recognized.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: identifying brand or ear-cut (`quranic:root_001650:B001/m01`); reading character from a visible trace (`quranic:root_001650:B002/m01`); hanging ear-tag (`quranic:root_000647:B001/m01`); outsider recognized by an attached tag (`quranic:root_000647:B002/m01`); pedigree mark (`quranic:root_000647:B003/m01`); manifest sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); distinguishing mark or banner (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); split upper lip (`quranic:root_001040:B004/m01`); nose or animal snout (`quranic:root_000404:B001/m01`); head-raised anger and pride (`quranic:root_000404:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The brand on the snout materializes social legibility. `زَنِيم` adds an attached tag that identifies an alien affiliation, while the “sign” and “mark” senses turn bodily appearance into evidence that observers interpret.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Oil, pigment, dye, and fine patterning alter a body or textile until its visible state may conceal its underlying condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: oil coating (`quranic:root_000497:B001/m01`); soft social dissimulation (`quranic:root_000497:B002/m01`); iridescent cloth (`quranic:root_001252:B010/m01`); patterned cloth that “lies” by appearance (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`); close ornamental lines (`quranic:root_001557:B007/m02`); contrasting fleck or gleam (`quranic:root_001557:B008/m01`); perfumed pigment (`quranic:root_000434:B010/m01`); visible beauty mark (`quranic:root_001650:B005/m01`); dye-bearing plant (`quranic:root_001650:B006/m01`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Assay Exposes Formation and Moral Texture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Pressure reveals whether a formed thing is sound, rough, delayed, brittle, or fit for its intended work.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Character is treated like material under assay: measured before formation, tested by fire or ordeal, and disclosed through hardness, lag, excess, and capacity for repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pride Hardens; Repair Restores Fit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Self-magnification and head-raised anger harden a person against correction, while repair, exchange, and selection restore useful form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: arrogant self-enlargement (`quranic:root_001029:B006/m01`); angry raised-head pride (`quranic:root_000404:B004/m02`); imposing judgment on another (`quranic:root_001272:B010/m01`); nurture and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m02`); material or practical repair (`quranic:root_001119:B001/m01`); transformation or replacement (`quranic:root_001119:B003/m01`); selected excellence (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Pride is a deformation of magnitude into self-hardening. The counter-process is not mere condemnation but correction: tend, repair, exchange the damaged state, and select what is genuinely fit.
